content: Intra-abdominal neuroblastoma must be carefully distinguished from other conditions that present with abdominal swelling and constipation. These conditions include Wilms tumor, rhabdomyosarcoma, ganglioneuroma, and ganglioneuroblastoma. Similarly, intra-thoracic neuroblastoma must be differentiated from other diseases that cause symptoms such as shortness of breath and chronic cough. These conditions include intrathoracic lymphoma, extra-lobar pulmonary sequestration, round pneumonia, ganglioneuroma, and ganglioneuroblastoma.
